description: Process inbound invoices from receipt through approval to payment scheduling.

steps.description: Receive and log an inbound invoice from email, upload, or scan.

inputs.name: invoice-source
inputs.desc: The raw invoice (email attachment, uploaded file, or scanned image)

inputs.name: vendor-name
inputs.desc: The vendor or supplier name if known

outputs.name: received-invoice
outputs.desc: The invoice file registered in the processing queue

outputs.name: receipt-timestamp
outputs.desc: When the invoice was received and logged

process: Accept the invoice from the source channel (email, upload portal, or scanner).
Assign a unique invoice tracking number.
Log the receipt with timestamp and source channel.
Place the invoice in the processing queue.

steps.description: Extract key fields from the invoice: vendor, amount, date, line items, and PO number.

inputs.name: received-invoice
inputs.desc: The invoice file to extract from

outputs.name: extracted-fields
outputs.desc: Structured data: vendor, invoice number, date, due date, line items, total amount, PO number

outputs.name: extraction-confidence
outputs.desc: Confidence score for each extracted field

process: Parse the invoice to identify vendor name, invoice number, date, and due date.
Extract line items with descriptions, quantities, unit prices, and amounts.
Identify the PO number or reference if present.
Calculate the invoice total and compare against the stated total.

steps.description: Validate the extracted invoice data against the corresponding purchase order.

inputs.name: extracted-fields
inputs.desc: Structured invoice data

inputs.name: extraction-confidence
inputs.desc: Confidence scores for extracted fields

outputs.name: validation-result
outputs.desc: Pass, fail, or exception with details on each mismatch

outputs.name: variance-report
outputs.desc: Line-by-line comparison of invoice versus PO

process: Look up the purchase order by PO number.
Compare invoice line items against PO line items (quantities, prices, descriptions).
Flag any variances that exceed the tolerance threshold.
Produce the validation result and variance report.

steps.description: Route the invoice for approval based on amount thresholds and department rules.

inputs.name: extracted-fields
inputs.desc: Structured invoice data including amount

inputs.name: validation-result
inputs.desc: Whether the invoice passed PO validation

outputs.name: approval-decision
outputs.desc: Approved, rejected, or escalated with approver name and timestamp

outputs.name: approval-notes
outputs.desc: Any notes or conditions from the approver

process: Determine the approval routing based on invoice amount and department.
Send the invoice to the designated approver with the validation report.
Track the approval status against the SLA.
Record the approval decision and any conditions.

steps.description: Post the approved invoice to the accounting system and schedule the payment.

inputs.name: extracted-fields
inputs.desc: Structured invoice data

inputs.name: approval-decision
inputs.desc: The approval decision and conditions

outputs.name: posting-confirmation
outputs.desc: Confirmation that the invoice was posted to the ledger

outputs.name: payment-schedule
outputs.desc: Scheduled payment date and method

process: Post the invoice to the general ledger with the correct GL coding.
Schedule the payment based on payment terms and cash flow.
Send confirmation to the vendor if required.
Produce the processed invoice record.

description: Generate contracts from templates, route for review, and collect signatures.

steps.description: Select the contract template based on the deal type and engagement terms.

inputs.name: deal-type
inputs.desc: The type of deal (service agreement, NDA, license, purchase order, partnership)

inputs.name: deal-parameters
inputs.desc: Key terms: parties, scope, pricing, duration, special conditions

outputs.name: selected-template
outputs.desc: The contract template chosen for this deal type

outputs.name: template-variables
outputs.desc: List of fields that need to be populated in the template

process: Match the deal type to the available contract templates.
Verify the template version is current and approved by legal.
Identify all variable fields that require population.
Note any optional clauses to include or exclude based on deal parameters.

steps.description: Populate the contract template with deal-specific data.

inputs.name: selected-template
inputs.desc: The contract template to populate

inputs.name: deal-parameters
inputs.desc: Deal-specific data for the variable fields

outputs.name: draft-contract
outputs.desc: The populated contract draft ready for review

outputs.name: population-log
outputs.desc: Record of which fields were populated and from what source

process: Map deal parameters to template variable fields.
Populate each field with the correct value (parties, dates, amounts, terms).
Include or exclude optional clauses based on the deal structure.
Generate the draft contract document.

steps.description: Route the draft contract for internal legal review and incorporate feedback.

inputs.name: draft-contract
inputs.desc: The populated contract draft

outputs.name: reviewed-contract
outputs.desc: The contract with legal review comments incorporated

outputs.name: review-notes
outputs.desc: Legal reviewer's notes and any risk flags

process: Send the draft to the assigned legal reviewer.
Track the review against the turnaround SLA.
Incorporate the reviewer's redlines and comments.
Produce the reviewed contract ready for signature.

steps.description: Send the contract for counterparty signature and file the executed copy.

inputs.name: reviewed-contract
inputs.desc: The reviewed and approved contract

inputs.name: review-notes
inputs.desc: Any conditions or notes from legal review

outputs.name: executed-contract
outputs.desc: The fully signed contract

outputs.name: contract-record
outputs.desc: Filing record with contract number, parties, dates, and storage location

process: Send the contract to the counterparty for signature via the e-signature platform.
Track signature status and send reminders as needed.
Collect the executed contract with all signatures.
File the executed contract and produce the contract record.

description: Classify incoming documents by type, extract metadata, and route to the correct processing queue.

steps.description: Identify the type of an incoming document (invoice, contract, letter, form, report).

inputs.name: incoming-document
inputs.desc: The document to classify

inputs.name: classification-rules
inputs.desc: Rules or model used to classify document types

outputs.name: document-type
outputs.desc: The identified document type

outputs.name: classification-confidence
outputs.desc: Confidence score for the classification

process: Analyze the document structure, layout, and content.
Match against known document type patterns (invoices have amounts and vendor info, contracts have signature blocks, etc.).
Assign the document type with a confidence score.
Flag low-confidence classifications for manual review.

steps.description: Extract metadata from the classified document: date, author, reference numbers, and key entities.

inputs.name: incoming-document
inputs.desc: The document to extract metadata from

inputs.name: document-type
inputs.desc: The identified document type to guide extraction

outputs.name: document-metadata
outputs.desc: Extracted metadata: date, author, reference numbers, subject, key entities

outputs.name: extraction-log
outputs.desc: Record of what was extracted and confidence levels

process: Extract the document date, author, and reference numbers.
Identify key entities (company names, person names, account numbers).
Extract the subject or title if present.
Compile the metadata record.

steps.description: Route the classified document to the appropriate processing queue based on type and metadata.

inputs.name: document-type
inputs.desc: The identified document type

inputs.name: document-metadata
inputs.desc: Extracted metadata for routing decisions

outputs.name: routing-destination
outputs.desc: The queue or team the document was routed to

outputs.name: classification-record
outputs.desc: Complete record: document type, metadata, routing, timestamp

process: Match the document type and metadata to the routing rules.
Route invoices to accounts payable, contracts to legal, correspondence to the relevant department.
Tag and index the document for search and retrieval.
Produce the classification record.

description: Extract structured data from scanned or image-based documents using OCR.

steps.description: Preprocess the scanned image for OCR: deskew, denoise, and enhance.

inputs.name: scanned-document
inputs.desc: The scanned image or PDF to process

inputs.name: preprocessing-settings
inputs.desc: Settings for deskew angle, noise reduction, and contrast enhancement

outputs.name: preprocessed-image
outputs.desc: The cleaned and enhanced image ready for OCR

outputs.name: preprocessing-report
outputs.desc: Summary of corrections applied (rotation, noise removal, enhancement)

process: Detect and correct skew angle.
Apply noise reduction to remove scanning artifacts.
Enhance contrast and sharpness for text readability.
Output the preprocessed image.

steps.description: Run OCR on the preprocessed image to extract raw text.

inputs.name: preprocessed-image
inputs.desc: The cleaned image ready for OCR

outputs.name: raw-ocr-text
outputs.desc: The raw text extracted by OCR with position data

outputs.name: ocr-confidence-map
outputs.desc: Per-character or per-word confidence scores

process: Run the OCR engine on the preprocessed image.
Capture the extracted text with bounding box positions.
Record confidence scores for each text region.
Identify regions where text could not be read.

steps.description: Parse the raw OCR text into structured fields based on the document layout.

inputs.name: raw-ocr-text
inputs.desc: Raw text with position data from OCR

inputs.name: ocr-confidence-map
inputs.desc: Confidence scores for each text region

outputs.name: structured-data
outputs.desc: Parsed fields (names, dates, amounts, addresses, reference numbers)

outputs.name: low-confidence-flags
outputs.desc: Fields with low confidence that need human review

process: Identify field labels and their associated values using layout analysis.
Parse dates, amounts, and reference numbers into their data types.
Validate extracted values against expected formats (date patterns, numeric ranges).
Flag any fields below the confidence threshold for human review.

steps.description: Validate the extracted data and produce the final extraction record.

inputs.name: structured-data
inputs.desc: Parsed fields from OCR

inputs.name: low-confidence-flags
inputs.desc: Fields flagged for human review

outputs.name: validated-extraction
outputs.desc: Final validated data record with all fields confirmed

outputs.name: extraction-report
outputs.desc: Summary of extraction quality, corrections made, and fields reviewed

process: Cross-check extracted fields against each other for consistency (e.g., line item totals match the stated total).
Present low-confidence fields for human verification.
Apply corrections from human review.
Produce the final extraction record and quality report.

description: Route documents through a multi-level approval workflow with tracking and audit trail.

steps.description: Define the approval rules: who approves what, at what thresholds, and in what order.

inputs.name: document-types
inputs.desc: The types of documents that require approval

inputs.name: approval-policies
inputs.desc: Organizational policies governing approval authority and thresholds

outputs.name: approval-matrix
outputs.desc: Matrix mapping document types and amounts to approvers and escalation paths

outputs.name: approval-sla
outputs.desc: Response time expectations for each approval level

process: List the document types that require approval (invoices, contracts, expense reports, purchase requests).
Define the approval thresholds and routing for each type.
Set the escalation path for overdue approvals.
Document the SLA for each approval level.

steps.description: Submit a document for approval and notify the designated approver.

inputs.name: document-for-approval
inputs.desc: The document submitted for approval

inputs.name: approval-matrix
inputs.desc: Rules determining who approves this document

outputs.name: submission-record
outputs.desc: Record of submission: document, approver, timestamp, SLA deadline

outputs.name: approver-notification
outputs.desc: Notification sent to the approver with the document and context

process: Determine the correct approver based on document type, amount, and department.
Submit the document with supporting context (summary, amount, requester, urgency).
Notify the approver and set the SLA timer.
Log the submission in the audit trail.

steps.description: Track approval status, send reminders, and handle rejections or resubmissions.

inputs.name: submission-record
inputs.desc: The pending approval submission

inputs.name: approval-sla
inputs.desc: SLA expectations for response

outputs.name: approval-outcome
outputs.desc: Approved, rejected, or returned for revision with approver comments

outputs.name: approval-audit-trail
outputs.desc: Complete audit trail: submission, reminders, decision, timestamp

process: Monitor the approval queue for responses.
Send reminders when the SLA deadline approaches.
Record the approval decision with the approver's comments.
If rejected, route back to the submitter with feedback for revision.

description: Manage records retention from inventory through scheduled destruction and legal hold.

steps.description: Inventory document types and map them to their retention requirements.

inputs.name: document-inventory
inputs.desc: List of document types in the organization

inputs.name: regulatory-requirements
inputs.desc: Legal, regulatory, and business retention requirements

outputs.name: retention-schedule
outputs.desc: Each document type mapped to its retention period, authority, and disposition method

outputs.name: gap-analysis
outputs.desc: Document types without defined retention periods

process: List all document types and their storage locations.
Map each document type to its legal, regulatory, or business retention requirement.
Set the retention period and disposition method (destroy, archive, transfer).
Identify any gaps where retention is undefined.

steps.description: Classify existing records against the retention schedule.

inputs.name: retention-schedule
inputs.desc: The approved retention schedule

outputs.name: classified-records
outputs.desc: Records categorized by retention status (active, eligible for destruction, on hold)

outputs.name: classification-summary
outputs.desc: Counts and volumes by retention category

process: Scan existing records and match to the retention schedule.
Calculate the retention expiry date for each record.
Identify records eligible for destruction.
Flag records under legal hold.

steps.description: Schedule and execute destruction for expired records while managing legal holds.

inputs.name: classified-records
inputs.desc: Records with retention status

inputs.name: classification-summary
inputs.desc: Summary of records by category

outputs.name: destruction-log
outputs.desc: Record of what was destroyed, when, by whom, and the authority

outputs.name: retention-compliance-report
outputs.desc: Compliance status: records on schedule, overdue for destruction, on hold

process: Prepare the destruction list excluding records on legal hold.
Execute destruction with proper chain of custody documentation.
Log each destruction event with date, method, witness, and authority.
Produce the retention compliance report.

description: Convert paper forms to digital forms with validation and conditional logic.

steps.description: Audit current paper forms in use and prioritize for digitization.

inputs.name: form-inventory
inputs.desc: List of paper forms currently in use across the organization

inputs.name: digitization-criteria
inputs.desc: Criteria for prioritization (volume, error rate, processing time)

outputs.name: prioritized-forms
outputs.desc: Forms ranked by digitization priority with rationale

outputs.name: form-analysis
outputs.desc: Each form's fields, logic, dependencies, and current pain points

process: Collect all paper forms in active use.
Analyze each form's volume, error rate, and processing cost.
Rank forms by digitization impact.
Document each form's fields, rules, and dependencies.

steps.description: Design the digital version of the form with fields, validation, and conditional logic.

inputs.name: form-analysis
inputs.desc: The paper form's fields, rules, and dependencies

outputs.name: form-design
outputs.desc: Digital form specification with fields, types, validation rules, and conditional logic

outputs.name: user-experience-notes
outputs.desc: Notes on layout, mobile compatibility, and accessibility

process: Map each paper field to a digital field type (text, dropdown, date, checkbox, file upload).
Add validation rules (required fields, format checks, range constraints).
Design conditional logic (show/hide fields based on other answers).
Plan the layout for desktop and mobile use.

steps.description: Build the digital form in the selected platform and test with sample submissions.

inputs.name: form-design
inputs.desc: The form specification

outputs.name: built-form
outputs.desc: The working digital form in the platform

outputs.name: test-results
outputs.desc: Results from test submissions including edge cases

process: Build the form in the selected platform following the specification.
Configure the submission workflow (notifications, data storage, integrations).
Test with sample data covering happy paths and edge cases.
Fix any issues found during testing.

steps.description: Migrate from paper to digital with user training and transition support.

inputs.name: built-form
inputs.desc: The tested digital form

inputs.name: test-results
inputs.desc: Test results confirming the form works

outputs.name: migration-record
outputs.desc: Record of the migration: old form retired, new form live, users trained

outputs.name: digitization-report
outputs.desc: Before and after comparison of processing time, error rate, and cost

process: Train users on the new digital form.
Run both paper and digital in parallel during the transition period.
Retire the paper form once the digital version is validated in production.
Measure the improvement and produce the digitization report.

description: Set up document version control with naming conventions, access, and audit trail.

steps.description: Define the document naming convention and version numbering scheme.

inputs.name: document-types
inputs.desc: Types of documents to be version-controlled

inputs.name: organizational-standards
inputs.desc: Any existing naming or numbering standards

outputs.name: naming-convention
outputs.desc: The naming convention with examples for each document type

outputs.name: version-numbering-scheme
outputs.desc: Major, minor, and draft version numbering rules

process: Define the naming pattern (project code, document type, date, version).
Set the version numbering rules (when to increment major vs minor, draft conventions).
Provide examples for each document type.
Document exceptions and edge cases.

steps.description: Set up the storage platform with folder structure and access permissions.

inputs.name: naming-convention
inputs.desc: The approved naming convention

outputs.name: folder-structure
outputs.desc: The configured folder hierarchy with access permissions

outputs.name: access-matrix
outputs.desc: Who can view, edit, and approve documents in each area

process: Design the folder structure aligned to projects, departments, or document types.
Set access permissions (view, edit, approve) for each folder.
Configure the version history settings (how many versions to retain).
Set up the audit trail for changes.

steps.description: Write the version control policy covering check-in, check-out, and audit procedures.

inputs.name: naming-convention
inputs.desc: Naming and numbering rules

inputs.name: folder-structure
inputs.desc: Storage structure and permissions

inputs.name: access-matrix
inputs.desc: Access control rules

outputs.name: version-control-policy
outputs.desc: The complete version control policy document

outputs.name: quick-reference-guide
outputs.desc: One-page reference for daily use

process: Write the check-out and check-in procedures.
Define the review and approval workflow for version changes.
Specify the audit and compliance requirements.
Create the quick reference guide for end users.

description: Run a mail merge campaign from data preparation through document generation and distribution.

steps.description: Prepare the data source with clean, validated merge fields.

inputs.name: contact-list
inputs.desc: The raw contact list or data source for the merge

inputs.name: merge-fields
inputs.desc: The fields needed for the merge (name, address, account number, custom fields)

outputs.name: clean-data-source
outputs.desc: Validated and formatted data source ready for merge

outputs.name: data-quality-report
outputs.desc: Count of records, missing fields, duplicates removed

process: Import the contact list and map columns to merge fields.
Validate each record for completeness (no missing required fields).
Standardize formatting (names, addresses, dates).
Remove duplicates and produce the data quality report.

steps.description: Create the document template with merge field placeholders.

inputs.name: merge-fields
inputs.desc: The fields available for insertion

inputs.name: document-purpose
inputs.desc: What the merged document is for (letter, label, certificate, notice)

outputs.name: merge-template
outputs.desc: The document template with placeholders for each merge field

outputs.name: template-preview
outputs.desc: Preview of the template with sample data inserted

process: Design the document layout for the stated purpose.
Insert merge field placeholders at the correct positions.
Preview the template with sample data from the data source.
Verify formatting holds across different data lengths.

steps.description: Run the merge, review the output, and distribute the merged documents.

inputs.name: clean-data-source
inputs.desc: Validated data source

inputs.name: merge-template
inputs.desc: Template with merge placeholders

outputs.name: merged-documents
outputs.desc: The complete set of merged documents

outputs.name: campaign-record
outputs.desc: Record of the campaign: count sent, errors, distribution method

process: Run the merge to generate one document per record.
Review a sample of merged documents for correctness.
Distribute via the selected channel (print, email, upload).
Log the campaign results.

description: Set up and manage a digital signature workflow from platform selection through tracking.

steps.description: Select and configure the e-signature platform based on requirements.

inputs.name: signature-requirements
inputs.desc: Volume, compliance needs, integration requirements, and budget

inputs.name: document-types
inputs.desc: Types of documents that will use e-signatures

outputs.name: platform-selection
outputs.desc: Selected platform with rationale

outputs.name: platform-config
outputs.desc: Configuration settings: branding, templates, notification rules

process: Evaluate platforms against requirements (compliance, volume, integrations).
Select the platform that fits the use case.
Configure branding, notification templates, and default settings.
Set up integrations with existing document and contract systems.

steps.description: Prepare the document for signing: define signing order, roles, and signature fields.

inputs.name: document-to-sign
inputs.desc: The document that needs signatures

inputs.name: signing-parties
inputs.desc: Who signs, in what order, and what role each plays (signer, approver, observer)

outputs.name: prepared-envelope
outputs.desc: The document configured with signature fields, signing order, and recipient roles

outputs.name: signing-instructions
outputs.desc: Instructions for each signer on what to do

process: Place signature, initial, and date fields at the correct positions in the document.
Define the signing order (sequential or parallel).
Assign roles to each recipient (signer, approver, carbon copy, observer).
Set expiration date and reminder frequency.

steps.description: Send for signatures, track completion, and file the signed document.

inputs.name: prepared-envelope
inputs.desc: The document ready for signing

outputs.name: signed-document
outputs.desc: The fully executed document with all signatures

outputs.name: signature-audit-trail
outputs.desc: Complete audit trail: who signed, when, IP address, authentication method

process: Send the envelope to the first signer (or all signers if parallel).
Track signing progress and send reminders for unsigned envelopes.
Collect the completed document once all parties have signed.
File the signed document and produce the audit trail.
